testcases.notes: The temporal decoder, depth decoders, and Mimi codec run in FP16. Global selector 35 keeps only temporal block 31 and the following final norm/heads in FP32; pure FP16 makes the temporal hidden state non-finite, while this boundary passes the unchanged checkpoint-owned token contract.
